text.p: Results from the latest round of Sunday League (40 overs) cricket matches:
At Edgbaston: Warwickshire beat Yorkshire by 4 wickets. Yorkshire 184-9 in 39.3 overs - innings complete (A.Donald 4-32). Warwickshire 186-6 in 37.4 overs.
At Taunton: Somerset beat Sussex by 6 wickets. Sussex 109 all out in 31.4 overs (A.Caddick 4-19). Somerset 111-4 in 23.2 overs (M.Lathwell 53 not out).
At Chelmsford: Essex beat Durham by 2 wickets. Durham 208-7 in 39.5 overs - innings complete (J.Morris 110). Essex 210-8 in 38.4 overs (D.Law 82; M.Saggers 4-35).
At Old Trafford: Lancashire beat Nottinghamshire by 2 wickets. Nottinghamshire 139 all out in 39.4 overs. Lancashire 141-8 in 37.5 overs (J.Gallian 54 not out).
At The Oval: Surrey beat Gloucestershire by 5 wickets. Gloucestershire 176-9 in 40 overs (M.Alleyne 58). Surrey 177-5 in 40 overs.
At Lord's: Middlesex beat Derbyshire by 4 wickets. Derbyshire 178 all out in 39.4 overs (C.Adams 52). Middlesex 179-6 in 39.5 overs (M.Gatting 82 not out).
At Canterbury: Kent beat Glamorgan by 8 runs. Kent 238-9 in 40 overs (M.Ealham 61). Glamorgan 230 all out in 39.2 overs (A.Dale 65, R.Croft 50; M.Ealham 5-41).
At Southampton: Leicestershire beat Hampshire by 38 runs. Leicestershire 231-6 in 40 overs (N.Johnson 54, B.Smith 51 not out). Hampshire 193 all out in 39.5 overs (K.James 50).
